== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Arch-Glacor can be fought in Normal Mode (NM) or Hard Mode (HM)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• NM can be fought in a group, but HM can only be fought solo</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Arch-Glacor's life points vary based on mode and enrage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Glacor </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="glacor">[[File:Glacor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107344935923743.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>glacor</nowiki>|<nowiki>glacor</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> slayer assignment applies to NM only</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span> [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=rPkAfi2w9CZJYxyKK7V0 <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]<span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;" title="AG Melee">https://files.catbox.moe/f4n39g.webp<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/7db4e5c75a4dca2a8bb21331fda34830abe8360157afe463ed8208466f3d21b0.webp Image source]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span> [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=MhE8Umpw79WhIYuJPIz9 <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]<span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;" title="NM AG Ranged">https://files.catbox.moe/fnces7.webp<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/02f557dda19c2ec1c26e0389d11d869b1bbcdce01f39189d12602cd392ca80c1.webp Image source]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span> [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=CYtiJmWEAZwOVNam77oN <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]</p>

</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:540px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://files.catbox.moe/6gqx0k.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FCYtiJmWEAZwOVNam77oN.png?alt=media Image source]</span></span></p>

<span id="fight-mechanics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Arch-Glacor randomly cycles through the 5 mechanics listed below</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each mechanic can only occur once per cycle, meaning a mechanic can </nowiki><em><nowiki>only</nowiki></em><nowiki> occur back-to-back if it is the last mechanic of a cycle and the first mechanic of the next</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In NM, mechanics can be toggled on or off to learn the fight, except for Creeping Ice</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In HM, all mechanics are enabled and enrage increases with every kill, with difficulty increasing too</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="auto-attacks-ranged-example-magic-example" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (</nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/XZgiuE5XNB.mp4 <nowiki>Ranged example</nowiki>]<nowiki> / </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/BtHNY8ND13.mp4 <nowiki>Magic example</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor primarily uses Magic and Ranged auto-attacks, with stronger style-swapping auto-attacks during </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Flurry</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Pray against the correct attack style </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deflectmage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deflectmage</nowiki>|<nowiki>deflectmage</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deflectrange">[[File:Deflect Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deflectrange</nowiki>|<nowiki>deflectrange</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if taking heavy damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="glacyte-minions-example" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Glacyte Minions</nowiki></ins> [https://img.pvme.io/images/kSB6UcI.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor becomes immune and summons 4 Glacyte minions. Each minion drops an unstable core on death.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>At 250%+ HM enrage, a tougher Bolstered Glacyte also spawns (however, if this is the first mechanic in the fight, this Bolstered Glacyte does </nowiki><em><nowiki>not</nowiki></em><nowiki> spawn).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use area of effect attacks to clear the minions </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spectralscythe2">[[File:Spectral Scythe 2.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spectralscythe2</nowiki>|<nowiki>spectralscythe2</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="threadsoffate">[[File:Threads of Fate icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>threadsoffate</nowiki>|<nowiki>threadsoffate</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gchain">[[File:Greater Chain.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gchain</nowiki>|<nowiki>gchain</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="magmatemptest">https://files.catbox.moe/e1w1m7.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063454173532242.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cane">[[File:Hurricane.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cane</nowiki>|<nowiki>cane</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gflurry">[[File:Greater Flurry.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gflurry</nowiki>|<nowiki>gflurry</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ricochet">[[File:Ricochet.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ricochet</nowiki>|<nowiki>ricochet</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bombard">[[File:Bombard.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bombard</nowiki>|<nowiki>bombard</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Click the unstable cores only once </nowiki><strong><nowiki>all</nowiki></strong><nowiki> minions are dead</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="flurry-example" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Flurry</nowiki></ins> [https://img.pvme.io/images/0CU0qXf.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor's auto-attacks hit harder and rotate combat styles, with its Melee hit the strongest.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Pray against each combat style accordingly </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectRange">[[File:Deflect Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectRange</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for additional damage reduction</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="divert">[[File:Divert.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>divert</nowiki>|<nowiki>divert</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on melee swipes where appropriate</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="pillars-of-ice-example" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Pillars of Ice</nowiki></ins> [https://img.pvme.io/images/omGXX0a.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Creeping Ice forces you to one end of the arena, then moving beams cross the arena. Contact with a beam deals heavy damage and stuns you </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Move around the beams using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Watch the example above for one safe path through the mechanic</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In HM, an additional beam appears after the second beam</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="exposed-core-example" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Exposed Core</nowiki></ins> [https://img.pvme.io/images/j3d2YIxcr7.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor traps you in the centre of the arena, between its arms. The core deals increasing Magic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Kill </nowiki><em><nowiki>either</nowiki></em><nowiki> arm to escape</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use strong damaging abilities to break the arm quickly</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to reduce damage if needed</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="frost-cannon-example" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Frost Cannon</nowiki></ins> [https://img.pvme.io/images/20mFMPA.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Creeping Ice traps you at one end of the arena, then Arch-Glacor fires a beam dealing heavy Magic damage. In HM, the beam hits 3 times and the first hit stuns you </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Prioritise blocking the Magic attack(s) with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="anti">[[File:Anticipation.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>anti</nowiki>|<nowiki>anti</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> before the beam in HM to prevent the stun</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you miss this, don't panic and use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Example rotations:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In NM: use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to heal from the single hit</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In HM:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="anti">[[File:Anticipation.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>anti</nowiki>|<nowiki>anti</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span> [https://img.pvme.io/images/9t9EdxK.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="anti">[[File:Anticipation.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>anti</nowiki>|<nowiki>anti</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the final hit </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/9PyGvb4.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
